No templates found with those criteria maybe need also bond formed 6-7? Could search for amide formation by specifying bonds formed C-N and broken C-Cl. Let's try bonds_formed: ["6-7"]? Not sure. Use functional groups broken: "acyl chloride", formed: "amide". Already none. Could search for amide bond cleavage (reverse). Maybe template for amide hydrolysis: breaks amide, forms carboxylic acid and amine. So forward reaction (hydrolysis) breaks amide, forms carboxylic acid and amine. So we need reverse: amide formation. So search for functional_groups_broken: ["amide"], functional_groups_formed: ["acyl chloride","primary amine"]? Not sure.

Let's search for templates that break amide.
<thought>Search for templates where the forward reaction breaks an amide (hydrolysis) which would be the reverse of amide formation. This may give a template we can use for retrosynthetic disconnection of the amide bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["amide"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["carboxylic acid", "primary amines"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
